entities.summary: The University of São Tomé and Príncipe, USTP, is a public institution of higher education in São Tomé and Príncipe. It is the country's main institution dedicated to teaching, research, and university extension. It was established in 2014 by merging three older institutions of higher education: ISP, EFOPE and ICS.
